> Harmonized System (HS) Codes: 7013.37.0000 (Commercial Drinking Glasses, other than glass-ceramics / lead crystal), 7013.99.0000 (Decanters & Tableware), 4420.90.9000 (Wooden Presentation Boxes).

---

## 1. Commercial Pricing & Quotation Policy (B2B Policy)
- **No Fixed Public Pricing:** As a factory-direct OEM/ODM manufacturer, Jingyue Glass does not publish fixed public consumer prices because commercial quotations depend on:
  1. Total Order Quantity and batch production allocations (Standard MOQ 500–1,000 pcs; low MOQ from 100 sets for flagship wooden gift sets XZM015 & XZM108-A; laser proofing from 48 pcs);
  2. Selected Model, Capacity, and Glass Composition (Lead-Free Crystal / High-Borosilicate 3.3 / Soda-Lime);
  3. Custom Branding and Decoration Technique (Laser Engraving, 580°C Kiln-Fired Ceramic Decal, Silk Screen, UV Color Relief, 12% Gold Rim, Spray Coating, Electroplating, Metal Labels);
  4. Packaging Specification (5-ply Export Master Carton with Dividers vs Custom Wooden Presentation Box with Odorless EPE Pearl Cotton Insert vs Individual Mailer Box);
  5. Incoterms & Destination Port (FOB Wuhan/Shanghai, CIF, DDP Air Express or DDP Ocean Freight with customs clearance).
- **Fast RFQ Response:** Itemized formal commercial quotations are provided within 1 business hour upon receipt of project specifications.
- **Physical Sampling & Private Mold Policy:** In-stock blank samples are provided free of charge; custom decorated pre-production physical samples are dispatched in 3–5 working days; 100% of custom tooling and private mold costs are fully refundable/creditable upon reaching agreed cumulative production volume.

## 4. Packaging Protection & Zero-Breakage Export Standard (ISTA-1A Certified)
Jingyue Glass enforces a 6-stage standardized export packaging protocol:
1. **Individually Wrapped:** Each glass piece is enclosed in tissue paper and protective sleeves to prevent surface scratches and friction hazing during transport.
2. **Gift Box Protection:** Presentation gift boxes are protected with outer corrugated mailer sleeves and moisture barrier wrap for pristine unboxing.
3. **Odorless EPE Pearl Cotton Inserts:** High-density CNC-molded pearl cotton inserts (38°–45° shore hardness) cradle items securely with zero off-gassing and zero chemical odor (replacing toxic EVA foam).
4. **Full-Coverage Top Cushion Foam Layer:** Top foam pads lock items firmly in place against vertical vibration during air and ocean transit.
5. **5-Ply Reinforced Export Master Cartons:** Heavy-duty double-wall corrugated cartons with interlocking cell dividers withstand multi-tier container stacking.
6. **Palletized Ocean Freight:** Full stretch-wrap and corner-edge board reinforcement for forklift handling and containerized shipping.
- **1.2M Drop Test Protocol:** All packaging configurations undergo ISTA-1A drop testing (1 corner, 3 edges, 6 faces dropped from 1.2 meters onto solid concrete) achieving a 100% zero-breakage pass rate.

---

## 5. Regulatory Compliance & Certified Laboratory Test Reports
- **US California Proposition 65:** PASS (STQ Laboratory Official Test Report Reference: SZ2025091217-4E). Conforms to California settlement limits (Pb < 0.05 mg/L, Cd < 0.01 mg/L).
- **US FDA Food Contact Safety:** 100% compliant with FDA Compliance Policy Guides CPG 7117.06 (Cadmium) and CPG 7117.07 (Lead).
- **European Union LFGB & EC 1935/2004:** Non-detectable heavy metal release certified under German LFGB Section 30/31 and Framework Regulation (EC) No 1935/2004 (Report PTC23022404104C).
- **Phytosanitary ISPM 15:** Heat-treated solid wood presentation boxes carrying compliant IPPC stamps for global customs entry.
